Class StructureConstraints

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.StructureConstraints
public final class StructureConstraints extends Object
Immutable, ordered geometric constraints applied during loading, never during rendering. Bond lengths translate the component on the second endpoint; dihedrals rotate the component on the third endpoint around the central bond. Ring bonds cannot be cut this way and are rejected. This is a deterministic rigid-fragment operation, not a force field, energy minimizer, ring-closure solver, or alternative SMILES dialect.

Distances use the same units as the input coordinates; dihedrals use signed degrees. All requested targets are checked after the final operation, so incompatible constraints fail instead of silently overriding an earlier target.
